unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #2 on dario933/x402guard: "Recognize a Nano (XNO) exact-scheme accept - the allowance/replay bug class does not exist on that rail". Framed in its scanner rules (X402-REPLAY-NO-NONCE, SOL-UNLIMITED-APPROVAL exist because EVM-ERC20 has allowance/replay; a Nano block needs neither); additive recognize-nano-scheme so applicable-rule set shrinks honestly; no claim Nano is bug-free (SSRF/hardcoded seed still fail); offered nano-info (0.0005) read-side; disclosed public research. Verified OPEN, author dhyabi2, Nano+XNO in body.
